authorization_gate.required_action: Explicit user approval of this exact frozen protocol and proposed observed-sample risk caps before loading models or running enrollment/query inference. Record approval separately; do not edit frozen files.
authorization_gate.user_instruction_reference: Resume request section11: preliminary criteria; prompt delivery is not implicit approval of all risk decisions.

dataset_split.processing_order: Numeric identity, numeric ordinal; all 15 enrollment records then all 30 query records; fixed manifest roles; no outcome-dependent ordering or replacement

source_integrity: Verify provenance/manifest/protocol frozen SHA and every source SHA/decoded RGB pixel SHA before use; STOP on mismatch; no overwrites.

pipeline.input: OpenCV decode original JPEG to uint8 BGR; cv2.cvtColor BGR2RGB at original 640x480; no resize before MTCNN
pipeline.detector: Bundled MTCNN; exact evaluation_pipeline_profile.json defaults/config, networks eval() and torch.inference_mode()
pipeline.alignment: Existing extract_faces_rgb size=160 align=True, five-point similarity; exact adapter; require exactly one face, no largest-face fallback
pipeline.facenet: Existing bundled ONNX and preprocessing (pixel-127.5)/128.0; RGB NCHW; 512D float32 unit embedding; unchanged extraction
pipeline.enrollment: Existing enroll_person_from_images and existing representative mean_float64_then_L2_to_float32; three fixed original images per Known, five-ID complete gallery
pipeline.sqlite: New controlled temporary registry using existing SQLite interfaces; never open/write historical databases; no permanent registry
pipeline.model_loads: Load MTCNN and FaceNet once only after explicit approval and integrity PASS
pipeline.scores: One enrollment extraction and one query extraction per source image; one five-ID cosine ranking per query, shared by V1/V2. Existing cosine_similarity/match_embedding semantics; lexical person_id tie break.
pipeline.decisions: Apply both fixed binary64 thresholds to identical saved score records; derive score replay without model inference; cross-check existing decision API using same embeddings in RAM; no vector/BLOB in reports.

failure_policy.zero_multiple_face: Explicit query pipeline failure; do not choose a different face or replace source
failure_policy.alignment_adapter_embedding_failure: Retain query in planned denominator, no Unknown rejection credit; log stage/type without face data
failure_policy.enrollment_failure: STOP independent comparison as INCONCLUSIVE if any of 15 enroll images fails; no dropped image/identity or alternate source. Planned gallery remains 5.
failure_policy.query_failure_accounting: K0=15,U0=15. Known A+R+W+FK=15; Unknown UA+UR+FU=15. Failures are separate from valid rejection/false-accept counts.
failure_policy.serious_coverage_rule: Conservative proposal requires all 30 queries usable and all 5 enrollments complete for a V2 recommendation; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE with failure breakdown.

metrics.symbols: A=Known correct accept;R=Known reject;W=Known wrong-ID accept;UA=Unknown false accept;UR=Unknown correct reject;FK/FU=pipeline failures;nK/nU=usable queries

primary.query_FPIR_E2E: UA/15, accompanied by nU/15 coverage and FU/15 failure; no interpretation as population FAR

conditional.known_false_rejection: R/nK; failures excluded and separately reported

metrics.outputs: counts, denominators, percentages, V2-V1 differences, query and identity breakdown, differing-decision records, failure counts by detection/alignment/adapter/embedding stage, coverage
metrics.timing: If measured, one shared processing-time record per query plus threshold-replay time; not two separate inference benchmarks.

decision_criteria_proposal.known_improvement: A_V2>A_V1 on same 15 Known planned queries
decision_criteria_proposal.coverage: Identical 30 query records/scores; full 30/30 usable query coverage and all five complete enrollments for a V2 recommendation
decision_criteria_proposal.tie: RETAIN_V1 when outcomes equivalent and no unresolved data/technical limitation; avoid needless runtime change
decision_criteria_proposal.criteria_fail: RETAIN_V1 if valid complete comparison clearly fails approved requirements; INCONCLUSIVE for insufficient/ambiguous data, serious failures or missing approval
decision_criteria_proposal.sample_risk_scope: Zero observed errors in these 15 Unknown and 15 Known queries is a proposed small-sample criterion only, not proof of zero FAR or an approved deployment risk tolerance.

limitations: 45 source images,10 dependent identity clusters,only5 Unknown identities/15 Unknown queries; one query changes stratum rate by about6.67 percentage points.
Gallery5 differs from historical gallery3; report this; do not pool datasets.
No pretraining VGGFace2 identity isolation proof, no real-person FEI/IMM mapping, no visual near-duplicate verification.
No production-grade/universal-optimum/webcam claim; no image augmentation/threshold fitting/finalV1 reuse.
stop_conditions: Frozen or raw source integrity mismatch
runtime_policy: Evaluation/recommendation only. Existing source/model/database/notebook/config/README/source projects unchanged. Any integration and rollback plan is a separate user-approved change; no cleanup/commit/push.
